Yes, that's the dedicated spot I pictured. Clicking the "Read later" tab dropped me into a clean view with just the NASA bookmark — the one thing I'd actually marked to get back to — and nothing else cluttering it. That's the whole point for me: a place where my unfinished reading sits by itself, so the stuff I meant to read doesn't get lost in everything else I've ever saved. And the "All bookmarks" tab right beside it means flipping back to my whole collection is one click away.

So having the two as side-by-side tabs feels natural, and the queue itself is exactly the "things I still mean to read" place I wanted. Happy with this.
